{{Quote|Commander. We are receiving a coded transmission from Commander Dofine.|Unidentified Neimoidian subordinate to Nap Lagard|<ref name="CoD" />}}
A [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] was '''subordinate''' to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nap Lagard]] and served as a [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] aboard the [[Acquisitor (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|''Acquisitor'']], a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]<ref name="CoD" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref>
